question: Find pairs of different molecules tested in the same assay and standard type, where both have 10–15 heavy atoms, fewer than 5 activities in that assay, fewer than 2 duplicate activities, non-null standard values, and pChEMBL values over 10. For each pair, report the maximum heavy atom count, the latest publication date (calculated based on the document's rank within the same journal and year, and map it to a synthetic month and day), the highest document ID, classify the change in standard values as 'increase', 'decrease', or 'no-change' based on their values and relations, and generate UUIDs from their activity IDs and canonical SMILES.

-- Final complete query
WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as standard_value,
    a.standard_type,
    CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) as pchembl_value,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) as heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
    ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
    ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE cp.heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL AND cp.heavy_atoms != ''
    AND CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.pchembl_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
activity_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    molregno,
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    COUNT(*) as act_count,
    SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) as dup_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY molregno, assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT fa.*
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN activity_counts ac 
    ON fa.molregno = ac.molregno 
    AND fa.assay_id = ac.assay_id 
    AND fa.standard_type = ac.standard_type
),
qualifying_docs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id FROM qualifying
),
docs_pub AS (
  SELECT 
    d.doc_id,
    d.year,
    d.journal,
    d.first_page,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.journal, d.year ORDER BY CAST(d.first_page AS INT64)) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.journal, d.year) as total_in_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29` d
  WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM qualifying_docs)
),
docs_date AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    year,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_in_group <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, total_in_group - 1) * 11) + 1
    END as month,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_in_group <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE (FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, total_in_group - 1) * 308) - (FLOOR(FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, total_in_group - 1) * 308) / 28) * 28)) + 1
    END as day
  FROM docs_pub
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    q1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
    q1.molregno as molregno_1,
    q1.assay_id,
    q1.standard_type,
    q1.standard_value as std_val_1,
    q1.standard_relation as std_rel_1,
    q1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
    q1.canonical_smiles as smiles_1,
    q1.heavy_atoms as ha_1,
    q2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
    q2.molregno as molregno_2,
    q2.standard_value as std_val_2,
    q2.standard_relation as std_rel_2,
    q2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
    q2.canonical_smiles as smiles_2,
    q2.heavy_atoms as ha_2
  FROM qualifying q1
  JOIN qualifying q2 
    ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id 
    AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
    AND q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
pairs_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    p.*,
    COALESCE(d1.year, '1970') as year1,
    d1.month as month1,
    d1.day as day1,
    COALESCE(d2.year, '1970') as year2,
    d2.month as month2,
    d2.day as day2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN docs_date d1 ON p.doc_id_1 = d1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN docs_date d2 ON p.doc_id_2 = d2.doc_id
),
pairs_with_pub_date AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN year1 > year2 THEN CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN year2 > year1 THEN CONCAT(year2, '-', LPAD(CAST(month2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN month1 > month2 THEN CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN month2 > month1 THEN CONCAT(year2, '-', LPAD(CAST(month2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN day1 > day2 THEN CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      ELSE CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    END as latest_pub_date
  FROM pairs_with_dates
)
SELECT 
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  molregno_1,
  molregno_2,
  assay_id,
  standard_type,
  std_val_1,
  std_val_2,
  doc_id_1,
  doc_id_2,
  smiles_1,
  smiles_2,
  ha_1,
  ha_2,
  GREATEST(ha_1, ha_2) as max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date,
  GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN std_val_1 > std_val_2 AND std_rel_1 = '=' AND std_rel_2 = '=' THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN std_val_1 < std_val_2 AND std_rel_1 = '=' AND std_rel_2 = '=' THEN 'increase'
    WHEN std_val_1 = std_val_2 AND std_rel_1 = '=' AND std_rel_2 = '=' THEN 'no-change'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END as change_type,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, activity_id_2)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
FROM pairs_with_pub_date
ORDER BY activity_id_1, activity_id_2

### Standard Change Classification:
Determines whether the standard value between two molecules has increased, decreased, or stayed the same:
'decrease': If standard_value_1 >(>>) standard_value_2 and measurement relations do not conflict.
'increase': If standard_value_1 <(<<) standard_value_2 and measurement relations do not conflict.

### How to Got the publication Date
To compute a publication date for each document, we use the following method, which assigns a date based on the document's relative position within its journal and year, ordered by its first page number.

#### 1. Year Calculation

- **Year**: Use the document's publication year as the year in the date.
  - If the document's year is known, use that year.
  - If the year is missing or unavailable, default to **1970**.

#### 2. Month Calculation

- **Grouping**: For all documents within the same **journal** and **year**, group them together.
- **Ordering**: Within each group, order the documents by their `first_page` number (converted to an integer).
- **Percent Rank Computation**:
  - Calculate the **percent rank** of each document in the ordered list.
  - **Percent Rank Formula**:

    $$\text{Percent Rank} = \frac{\text{Rank of Document} - 1}{\text{Total Documents in Group} - 1}$$

    - The rank starts at 1 for the first document.
    - The percent rank ranges from 0 to 1.
- **Month Assignment**:

{"sql": "-- Final complete query
WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as standard_value,
    a.standard_type,
    CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) as pchembl_value,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) as heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
    ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
    ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE cp.heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL AND cp.heavy_atoms != ''
    AND CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.pchembl_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
activity_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    molregno,
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    COUNT(*) as act_count,
    SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) as dup_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY molregno, assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT fa.*
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN activity_counts ac 
    ON fa.molregno = ac.molregno 
    AND fa.assay_id = ac.assay_id 
    AND fa.standard_type = ac.standard_type
),
qualifying_docs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id FROM qualifying
),
docs_pub AS (
  SELECT 
    d.doc_id,
    d.year,
    d.journal,
    d.first_page,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.journal, d.year ORDER BY CAST(d.first_page AS INT64)) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.journal, d.year) as total_in_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29` d
  WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM qualifying_docs)
),
docs_date AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    year,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_in_group <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, total_in_group - 1) * 11) + 1
    END as month,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_in_group <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE (FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, total_in_group - 1) * 308) - (FLOOR(FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, total_in_group - 1) * 308) / 28) * 28)) + 1
    END as day
  FROM docs_pub
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    q1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
    q1.molregno as molregno_1,
    q1.assay_id,
    q1.standard_type,
    q1.standard_value as std_val_1,
    q1.standard_relation as std_rel_1,
    q1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
    q1.canonical_smiles as smiles_1,
    q1.heavy_atoms as ha_1,
    q2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
    q2.molregno as molregno_2,
    q2.standard_value as std_val_2,
    q2.standard_relation as std_rel_2,
    q2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
    q2.canonical_smiles as smiles_2,
    q2.heavy_atoms as ha_2
  FROM qualifying q1
  JOIN qualifying q2 
    ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id 
    AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
    AND q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
pairs_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    p.*,
    COALESCE(d1.year, '1970') as year1,
    d1.month as month1,
    d1.day as day1,
    COALESCE(d2.year, '1970') as year2,
    d2.month as month2,
    d2.day as day2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN docs_date d1 ON p.doc_id_1 = d1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN docs_date d2 ON p.doc_id_2 = d2.doc_id
),
pairs_with_pub_date AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN year1 > year2 THEN CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN year2 > year1 THEN CONCAT(year2, '-', LPAD(CAST(month2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN month1 > month2 THEN CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN month2 > month1 THEN CONCAT(year2, '-', LPAD(CAST(month2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN day1 > day2 THEN CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      ELSE CONCAT(year1, '-', LPAD(CAST(month1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    END as latest_pub_date
  FROM pairs_with_dates
)
SELECT 
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  molregno_1,
  molregno_2,
  assay_id,
  standard_type,
  std_val_1,
  std_val_2,
  doc_id_1,
  doc_id_2,
  smiles_1,
  smiles_2,
  ha_1,
  ha_2,
  GREATEST(ha_1, ha_2) as max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date,
  GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN std_val_1 > std_val_2 AND std_rel_1 = '=' AND std_rel_2 = '=' THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN std_val_1 < std_val_2 AND std_rel_1 = '=' AND std_rel_2 = '=' THEN 'increase'
    WHEN std_val_1 = std_val_2 AND std_rel_1 = '=' AND std_rel_2 = '=' THEN 'no-change'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END as change_type,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, activity_id_2)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
FROM pairs_with_pub_date
ORDER BY activity_id_1, activity_id_2"}
